## For a new or changed memo

- [ ] One memo, one operational lesson.
- [ ] Every statement is in the runbook named under `runbook:` (say where if it is not obvious).
- [ ] The four first checks are read-only.
- [ ] State-changing and destructive actions are flagged as such under `caution:`.
- [ ] `scope:` says where this holds and what the runbook did not test.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes, and the regenerated `.md`, `README.md`, `LINKEDIN.md` and `dist/*.png` are committed.
- [ ] No secrets, real hostnames, addresses or customer names.
